scope: Prepared source only; Unity compile, install, Enable, actual asset writes and recovery remain unverified.

editorSession.enable: Explicit main-Editor menu and confirmation for 15 minutes, or coordinator EnableForOwnedTask(nonempty ownerToken, 1..120 minutes) within an approved resource lease. Both use the same mailbox implementation and a fresh 32-hex nonce.
editorSession.reload: Closes the session; pending old-nonce requests cannot run in a newly enabled instance.
editorSession.disable: Stops watcher/update callbacks and clears in-memory queue; writes disabled session state.

projectIdentity: Existing v1 projectId namespace: SHA256 UTF8 'unity-dev-room-v1\n' + normalized lowercase Windows workspace + '\n4d80e8531f4fc6d46b38bbafa382008e'. The canonical global Assets/Resources/DevsRealm/DocumentLibrary.asset GUID is verified; private Device parent GUID remains a separate source binding.

imageModes.none: All identity/path/hash strings empty; fileID and type zero.
imageModes.existing: stagingName empty; exact persistent Texture2D GUID/fileID/type=3, asset source SHA and meta SHA; optional Resources path resolves to that same object.

hashEncoding: SHA256 over fields framed by unsigned BE32 UTF8 byte length; arrays use BE32 count. Numeric identity values use invariant decimal strings. No trimming or newline normalization.

contentHash.resolvedIdentityCheck: No-op, recovery and applied all separately verify requested GUID/fileID/meta/path, or exact generated SHA path for staged media.

once: UUID request bytes are immutable. Terminal receipts are never overwritten. After attemptStarted, recovery can only confirm a full protected result or report unknown; no second write.
protected: main parent serialization including ordered tabs/categories/refs
all document/parent meta bytes including Device owner userData
blockedStates: any dirty object in either bound asset bundle
save: Undo on exact document; edit only existing content fields; one SaveAssetIfDirty on exact bound main asset; ForceSynchronousImport and re-resolve GUID/localFileID; recheck content, image identity, structure, provenance and meta.
failure: Before document save begins restore the formerly clean in-memory document and attempt MoveAssetToTrash only for exact media created by this request. After save begins, preserve the outcome and use unknown with read-only recovery; no YAML restoration or blind retry.
minimumDeployment: A single Editor-only DevRoomConsoleBridge.cs (Unity generates its .meta)
Durable .codex/console-content-sync/v2 mailbox/session at explicit Enable, outside Unity asset scanning
New Resources ConsoleMedia directory only when an approved request imports a new image
verifiedTestRunnerSource: com.unity.test-framework 1.7.0 UnityEditor.TestRunner/Api/TestRunnerApi.cs:217-220 exposes internal static bool IsRunActive() using all runner isRunning state. Reflection uses a zero-argument exact signature; unresolved or changed API blocks writes.
knownAcceptanceRequired: Compile in the actual main Editor during Building-approved resource window
Real standalone doc and Device subasset save/readback
Image existing/staged/removed and actual display rendering
domain reload and write-ahead crash recovery
knownProductConstraint: Current game IsValid requires nonempty summary and section title/body; pure-image empty-body sections require a separate game-side authoring/runtime decision.
